messages:
maria: Quick sync 15 - we need a short launch clip (single-sided asset) for enterprise security audiences: highlight security controls, SLA tiers, deployment options, a tiny benchmark callout, and clear inbound routing. Draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch/clip-draft

sam: Agree. Keep language punchy. Title idea: 'Secure Serving: What Execs Need to Know (60s)'.

sudha: For benchmark blurb: use non-sensitive phrasing: 'Typical tuned hosted config: median latency often sub-120ms; dedicated pools provide higher throughput and tenant isolation.'

jamal: Routing plan: tag `secure-clip`, send to Field AE + Sales Eng queue, and trigger Slack alert to #sales-enterprise. I'll add Intercom rule after copy is final.

eva: Design request: single-column, bold hero, three mini-cards (Controls / SLAs / Deploy). Keep icons single-color and include small benchmark footnote. Need EN/DE/FR outputs.

maria: SLA line draft: 'Enterprise SLA options up to 99.95% available. Dedicated tiers for strict isolation and compliance.'

sam: Minor tweak: add qualifier to latency claim: 'median latency often sub-120ms in tuned setups; actual SLAs depend on commitment and profile.'

jamal: Proposed Intercom pseudo-rule to review before I deploy:
```
if message.contains("secure" or "enterprise" or "secure-clip"):
  add_tag("secure-clip")
  assign_queue("Field-AE-Enterprise")
  notify_slack("#sales-enterprise", "New secure clip lead")
```
Please ack.
deploy-bot: docs: created revision v0.1 at https://docs.redwood/launch/secure-clip (rev: v0.1)

maria: Ack. I'll finish copy + send final PDF and web asset by EOD. Jamal please stage the routing rule. Eva please supply localized text and alt text. Thanks!
